content.text: Leviathan hah hradang hoi alawilah pawk na sawn thai han namaw,
rui hoi a lai hah a kam dawk na kawm thai maw.
A hnawng dawk hnâpacap na pacap sak teh,
Tamboung dawk laikaw na buen sak han na maw.
Nang koe ka hei vaiteh,
lawk kanemca hoi lawk a dei han na maw.
Nang hoi lawkkamnae sak vaiteh,
yungyoe okhai hanelah na la thai han na maw.
Tavaca patetlah ahni hoi reirei na pai han na maw.
Nama e yu lah la hanelah, na pâkhi thai han na maw.
Na huikonaw ni ama hoi buvennae hah a sak vaiteh,
hno kayawtnaw koe, ama teh a rei awh han namaw.
Tahroe donghmo hah a vuen dawk a kawi sak vaiteh,
tanga kamannaw hah tahroe hoi a lû dawk a kawi sak thai nahoehmaw.
A lathueng vah a kut toung nateh, tarantuknae hah pahnim hoeh,
khoeroe bout sak hanh lawi.
Ama tâ hane ngaihawinae hah a hrawnghrang doeh,
a mithmu vah a tâ thai hoeh e ao han namaw.
Ama lungtho sak hanelah apihai a lungtang mahoeh.
Hottelah pawiteh, apimaw ka hmalah ka kangdout thai han.
Kai ni ka patho hanelah apinimaw hmaloe na poe,
kalvan rahim e hnocawngca pueng hah kaie seng doeh.
A kut khok thoseh, athaonae pueng thoseh,
a takthai a thaonae, a meihawinae hah ka hrawk pouh mahoeh.
Alawilae a pho hah apinimaw a rading pouh thai han,
a tamboung hru bawk hni touh kâpâbawk e hah apinimaw rek a hnai thai han.
Apinimaw a minhmai takhang hah a paawng thai han,
takikathopounge a hânaw hah.
A keng dawk e a pho, a lakepnaw hah a kâoupnae naw lah a o,
mitnoutnae patetlah kacakcalah khan e lah ao.
Buet touh hoi buet touh khikkâcat teh,
a rahak dawk kahlî hai kâen thai hoeh.
Hotnaw teh buet touh hoi buet touh koung kâkuet teh,
kapek thai lah awm hoeh.
A hâ tangawn ni angnae a tâco sak teh,
a mit hah kho nueng kadai e patetlah ao.
A kâko hoi hmaito angnae a tâco teh,
hmaitali a tangpei.
A hnawng dawk hoi hmaikhunaw a tâco teh,
moi thawngnae hlaam dawk ka tangdawk e hoi,
ka kang e buruk patetlah ao.
A kâha ni hmaisaeinaw a kak teh,
a pahni dawk hoi hmaito a tâco.
A lahuen dawk thaonae ao teh,
a hmalah lungmathoenae hah a len.
A takthai hoi tharuinaw teh khakkâkuet teh,
kâtahruet thai hoeh e kacakpounge lah ao.
A lungthin teh talung patetlah a te,
Cakang phawmnae a rahim lae talung patetlah a te.
A thaw torei teh, athakaawme taminaw ni a taki awh,
a thao e a taki awh dawkvah, ka pathu e patetlah ao awh.
Ahni koe tahloi ka phat nakunghai tâ thai mahoeh,
pala, tahroe ni hai tâ thai mahoeh.
Sum hah cakong patetlah a pouk,
rahum hah thingke patetlah a pouk.
Licung ni yawng sak thai mahoeh,
Talung hoi dêi e hah ahni hanelah teh cakongkung patetlah ao.
Bongpai hah cakong patetlah a pouk teh,
pala dawk hoi duenae hah koe a panuikhai.
A vonpui vuen hah kahran poung e hlaam kâbawng e patetlah doeh a o,
tangdong um vah cangkatin e seh patetlah a tabo.
Ka dungpoung e tui hah hlaam patetlah a tangdo sak teh,
talî kadung poung e hah satuium patetlah a sak.
A cei tangcoungnae dawk angnae hah a hruek teh,
tami ni a dungpoung ati e tui hah sampo patetlah a pouk.
Takinae tawn laipalah, sak e lah ao teh,
talai van dawk ahni patetlae awm hoeh.
Ka rasang poung e hno pueng hah a khet nah,
ahni teh kâoup e catoun pueng dawk siangpahrang doeh telah a ti.
